author: Mercury
text: 8h Our latest Meridian print issue, Signal, is here. Meridian is the magazine we make here at Mercury that profiles founders building the next big thing, plus deep dives on cool ideas. When you’re building a company, the signals that matter don’t always come through cleanly. Signal is what’s left after filtering through the noise, and in a world overflowing with information, identifying it makes all the difference. This issue explores how founders develop a point of view about what actually matters, deciding what to measure and what to ignore when everyone (and everything) is competing for their attention. Featuring Surabhi Bhandari, Caroline Moss, Brandon Bryant, Gab Bois, Devin Gaffney, Alicia Scott, Filippo Sorcinelli, and more.
